questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the 'Sign In/Sign Up' instructions for new users?
options: To allow users to create accounts without an email address.
To guide users on how to invite teammates via the application portal.
To explain that team members 2-4 do not need to sign in to receive credit.
To provide a link for users who are having trouble logging in.
questions.answer: To guide users on how to invite teammates via the application portal.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT required for team members 2-4 to receive credit?
options: Having their contact information listed on the primary team member's application.
The eligibility form being fully submitted and approved.
Being listed as a primary team member.
questions.answer: Signing into their own account.

questions.question: What happens if a user attempts to use the 'Sign Up' button after creating an account?
options: The system will automatically create a new team member profile.
The user will receive an error message.
The user will be prompted to enter their email address again.
The user will gain access to the portal immediately.
questions.answer: The user will receive an error message.

questions.question: How can a user reset their password if they have forgotten it?
options: By contacting the support team directly.
By clicking the 'Forgot your password?' link and following prompts.
By using the primary team member's email address.
questions.answer: By clicking the 'Forgot your password?' link and following prompts.

questions.question: What is the minimum length requirement for a user-created password?
questions.answer: At least 8 characters.

questions.question: Which portal URL is provided for Team Member 2?
questions.answer: https://webportalapp.com/sp/team_member_2_portal_2026

questions.question: What is the eligibility form requirement for team members 2-4?
options: It must be fully submitted and approved before they can sign in.
It does not need to be submitted or approved.
It must be submitted by the primary team member only.
It is optional if the user has an email address.
questions.answer: It must be fully submitted and approved before they can sign in.

questions.question: What should a user do if their session expires due to inactivity?
questions.answer: Logout.

questions.question: Where can users find full submission guidelines and rules?
options: In the footer of the page.
By clicking a link provided in the welcome message.
On the primary team member's profile.
questions.answer: By clicking a link provided in the welcome message.

questions.question: Which email address is used for Team Member 3?
questions.answer: team_member_3_portal_2026

questions.question: According to the text, what were two major factors that led to food shortages and shrinking population rates in the seventeenth century?
options: Lavish lifestyles of wealthy nobles and royals
questions.answer: Agricultural and manufacturing slumps

questions.question: Which European states are identified in the text as constitutionalist states?
questions.answer: England and the Dutch Republic

questions.question: What was the primary cause of the Thirty Years' War as described in the text?
options: Religious divides between Catholics and Protestants
Climate changes known as the 'little ice age'
questions.answer: Religious divides between Catholics and Protestants

questions.question: How did the French state address the challenges of governing a vast empire during the seventeenth century?
options: By reducing taxes to maintain peace
By establishing new government bureaucracies and higher taxes
By abolishing all local power structures
By limiting the size of its standing army
questions.answer: By establishing new government bureaucracies and higher taxes

questions.question: What was the main obstacle faced by absolutist rulers in achieving central control over their realms?
options: Resistance from local nobles, the church, and provincial assemblies
questions.answer: Resistance from local nobles, the church, and provincial assemblies

questions.question: Which military force did Great Britain develop instead of a land army during the seventeenth century?
questions.answer: A navy

questions.question: What was the outcome of the Battle of the White Mountain in 1620?
options: Protestants defeated Catholics at the Battle of the White Mountain
The war ended with a peace treaty
questions.answer: Protestants defeated Catholics at the Battle of the White Mountain

questions.question: Which event marked a turning point in European history regarding religious conflicts?
questions.answer: The Peace of Westphalia

questions.question: How did the French army size change by the end of the seventeenth century?
options: It decreased significantly due to war casualties
It was reduced by foreign mercenaries
questions.answer: It grew to approximately 340,000 men

questions.question: What role did Cardinal Richelieu play in the context of French state-building?
options: He was a favorite who acquired power and fortune from his position
He led the Swedish army against the Habsburgs
He negotiated the Peace of Westphalia
questions.answer: He was a favorite who acquired power and fortune from his position
